translation: Não ⟨tenhas⟩ inveja dos homens maus nem ⟨desejes⟩ ⟨estar⟩ ⟨com⟩ ⟨eles⟩

tokens.rationale: The qualified negation (prohibition particle) — not just 'no' but an injunction; 'Não' captures the deprecative force.
Causative stem of 'to be zealous/jealous'; here contextually 'envy'. ⟨tenhas⟩ added for verbal coherence.
Prepositional ב + plural of 'man/Adam' — 'of men'. ⟨os⟩ added as definite article in English.
Adjective from 'evil/bad' — 'evil/wicked' applied to the men. 'Ma' is the standard evil-to-wicked shift in Proverbs context.
The prefixed ו here acts as 'and/or' joining two commands; 'nem' for the negative continuation fits the context.
Hiphil of 'desire/wish for' — causative 'make oneself desire'. ⟨desejes⟩ added for verbal conjugation.
Infinitive construct of 'to be'. Portuguese requires 'estar' here for existential sense; literal 'to be' would be ungrammatical.
Prepositional pronominal suffix here meaning 'with them' (from את + ם). Portuguese needs both the preposition ⟨com⟩ and the pronoun ⟨eles⟩.
